summary: Iter23 frontend-only review of 4 new advisor features + regression hooks. All 4 targets pass: (1) Per-Digest Hours persist independently (daily=10, weekly=15 survived reload) and each hour select is correctly disabled when its row's toggle is off; (2) Digest History 'RECENT SENDS' list is visible in the digest card and refreshes after each test send with correct kind/type/'not delivered'/timestamp (preview env — expected PASS); (3) Household Search on /clients Queue — search input visible, empty-state 'No households match "xyz999notreal".' renders for non-matches with testid household-search-empty, clearing input restores list, and typing 'Nguyen' does NOT trigger empty-state (filter matched); (4) advisor-today-panel renders on /dashboard with 'Today's tasks' (empty-state 'Nothing due today — you're all caught up.' when zero), 'Open Task Board' link navigates to /tasks, 4 today-attention-<client_id> items render with avg-score badges, and clicking an attention item navigates to /profile and sets active client as expected. Login via /api/auth/login + /api/auth/mfa/verify (shared TOTP JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP) succeeded; token injection into localStorage worked.

issues: Two of the top entries render primary name as 'Promo Owner · Needs Setup' with avg-score shown as '—'. These appear to be seed/promo households with no owner data filled in. Non-blocking but may look odd to end users; consider filtering out households missing a real primary name, or showing 'Unassigned household' label.

critical_code_review_comments: Queue household cards (/clients Queue view) have no stable data-testid on each card (only view-queue / new-household-button / household-search / household-search-empty exist). Automated regression counts must rely on empty-state presence as a proxy. Consider adding data-testid="queue-household-card-<id>" to each card for cleaner selector coverage.
seed_data_creation: None. Two preview-env digest sends were triggered (daily test + weekly test), which added 2 new 'not delivered' entries to Recent sends — expected per task note. Cleanup restored advisor digest_settings to {enabled:true, weekly_enabled:true, daily_hour:8, weekly_hour:8}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iter23 features confirmed working. For Household Search regression, note that queue cards lack per-card testids; use the household-search-empty testid presence/absence as the filter signal, or add testids to cards if deeper assertions are needed. advisor-today-panel today-task-<id> list could not be exercised with click-through because advisor had 0 due-today tasks at test time — click flow was validated via today-attention-<client_id> items (navigates to /profile correctly) and today-open-tasks (navigates to /tasks). Final state verified clean: daily_hour=8, weekly_hour=8, both toggles ON.
